quote.description: Exact quote or phrase from the meeting note that was classified as non-actionable chatter
quote.title: Quote

reason.description: Why this was classified as chatter rather than an actionable task
reason.title: Reason

id.description: Unique task identifier, e.g. task-1, task-2
id.title: Id

owner.description: Assigned team member name matching team roster, or null if unassigned
owner.title: Owner

due_date.description: ISO format date YYYY-MM-DD or null if unspecified/ambiguous
due_date.title: Due Date

goal.description: Goal ID or Goal Name matched to goals file, or null
goal.title: Goal

depends_on.description: List of task IDs that must be completed before this task can start
depends_on.title: Depends On

needs_confirmation.description: True if owner is missing, date is ambiguous, or instruction is unclear
needs_confirmation.title: Needs Confirmation

reason.description: Explanation when needs_confirmation is true; null otherwise
reason.title: Reason

source_quote.description: The exact snippet or sentence from the meeting note that supports this task
source_quote.title: Source Quote

meeting_date.description: Date of the meeting in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD
meeting_date.title: Meeting Date

tasks.description: List of proposed tasks extracted from the meeting
tasks.title: Tasks

ignored_remarks.description: List of remarks explicitly ignored as chatter
ignored_remarks.title: Ignored Remarks
